# What CI installs to check Probolos -- never what Probolos needs to run (that
# is pyudev alone, from pyproject.toml). Exact versions, dependencies included,
# so a new release of a linter or test tool cannot change a result on its own:
# a red build always means the code changed. Dependabot proposes updates as
# pull requests (see dependabot.yml), each to be read before merging.
#
# Locally: pip install -r .github/requirements-ci.txt

hypothesis==6.168.3
pyyaml==6.0.3
ruff==0.16.10

# coverage's TOML support on Python 3.10, which has no tomllib: without it
# coverage refuses to start with the [tool.coverage] config in pyproject.toml.
tomli==2.4.1 ; python_version < "3.11"

exceptiongroup==1.3.1 ; python_version < "3.11"
